# Section descriptor table

Ten 12-byte rows: run-time start, flash source and a flag for sections 1 to 10.

**Category:** table · **Address:** `0x60029b28` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-beta">Corroborated</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md)

The end of each section is not in the row: it is the operand of one mov in the end selector at 0x60045e6c. The flag is 1 for sections 6 and 7.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Olympus firmware research](../projects/oly-fw-analysis.md)): Ten 12-byte entries; the end selector is independent of the next descriptor. Source: [Finding space for added code](../sources/fishcu.code-space.md).
- **Static analysis** ([OM-Emu](../projects/om-emu.md)): Rows read from the block and tabulated with each loader end and the gap after it. Source: [OM-Emu study of Caduceus OM-3](../sources/emu.caduceus-om3.md).
